description: Answer a customer request with the shop's own quote: lines and prices your workers wrote, and the deposit you want when the customer books. Or set visit_first to offer to look before pricing. The deposit can be at most the lesser of 25% of the quote or $1,000. It is a direct charge on your own Stripe account, so your shop carries any chargeback or negative balance. Deposits work in every state; your shop is responsible for its state's rules on deposits, license disclosures and cancellation. Doing Work never sets or changes a price. A reply sent by an agent is shown to the customer as sent by the shop's assistant (owner or office).

deposit_minor.description: What the customer pays to book, in cents. Less than the total. Leave out for no deposit.

visit_first.description: Offer a visit before giving a price, instead of lines
